# LookerInstance

`looker.gcp.hfl.dev/v1alpha1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_looker_instance`. A Looker (Google Cloud core) instance.

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the looker.v1 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/looker/discokindtest/testdata/discokind/LookerInstance/`.

`spec.oauthConfig.clientSecret` takes `value`, or
`valueFrom.secretKeyRef` (`name`, `key`) of a Secret in the object's
namespace, which the controller reads (Config Connector's
`secret.Legacy`; `docs/design.md` decision 33):

```yaml
  oauthConfig:
    clientId: 123-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com
    clientSecret:
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: looker-oauth
          key: client-secret
```

The API never returns `oauthConfig.clientId` or `clientSecret`, so
neither is compared with the cloud; both are sent again when
`status.inputVersion` (a digest of the client ID and the Secret's name,
key and `resourceVersion`) changes, as when the Secret is rotated, at
the next reconcile. `TestLookerInstanceOAuthClientSecret` tests it on the
fake.
